Fig. 2. A scheme of resistance measurements in the two-point method. Changes in resistance were monitored by an automatic data acquisition unit Agilent 34970A for varioushydrogen concentrationsin nitrogen or in air.

text: The main goal of this paper is to investigate the electric resistance of a layered phthalocyanine and palladium (Pc + Pd) structure under the influence of various hydrogen concentrations in nitrogen and air. We show that during the interaction of hydrogen with bilayer structures metal-free phthalocyanine and palladium there occurs a strong change in the resistance of these structures. This would correspond to an acousto-electric effect in the SAW sensor system
